title: Locally constant lifts of a matrix splitting
statement: Let K be a field with separable closure S and G=Aut_K(S). Let A be a finite-dimensional central simple K-algebra, n>0 and e:S\otimes_K A\cong M_n(S) an S-algebra equivalence. There exist a locally constant b:G\to GL_n(S) and a homogeneous degree-two units cycle z [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] with g(e(1\otimes a))=b_g^{-1}e(1\otimes a)b_g and b_g g(b_h)=c_z(g,h)b_{gh}, where c_z is the evaluation defined in [def-sc-brauer-scalar-defect].

source.place: The scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6, Theorem 03R7, and Section 0DVG

proof.text: Obtain locally constant lifts and their conjugation identity from lem-sc-brauer-scalar-defect-lifts. Apply lem-sc-brauer-scalar-defect-cocycle to these lifts and combine the resulting witnesses b and z with their three properties.

proof_origin.place: Finite-basis lift choice using the proved Skolem--Noether lemma, followed by equation-two-cocycle before Tag 03R7.
